name: Dagashiya-san Hanjouki
source: When his grandfather was hospitalized he was entrusted the success of his pastry shop. Although he at first wasn't interested, eventually he began to enjoy himself. Cute small girls started to come visit the shop. Since there are no other guests can he get away with teasing them? Let's tease these girls who just keep coming back!
translation: 当他的祖父住院时，他被委托经营他的糕点店。虽然一开始他不感兴趣，但后来他开始乐在其中。可爱的小女孩开始来店里参观。既然没有其他客人，他能逃脱戏弄他们的责任吗？让我们来逗逗这些不断回来的女孩吧！
